forecastUncertaintyWidths: Show Wilson95 observed-rate intervals and widths for trailing156counts as descriptive uncertainty only; do not call them guaranteed future-ticket probability intervals.

fiveDistinctTicketsInSameCategory.qualification: Exact only under stated fitted type model, not a verified change in fair-draw chances.

limitations: Last104draws were used in earlier analyses and are exploratory reused history, not an untouched test.
Category selection and all partitions fixed before this experiment's scores; no tuning after results.
Large class frequency does not imply large probability for an individual combination because its cardinalityNc also matters.
For a fair independent draw exact class probability is qc and every individual ticket probability is1/8145060.
Wilson intervals, lifts, and their display ranking are descriptive exploratory summaries with no multiplicity adjustment.
Adjusted bootstrap intervals are approximate and do not remove historical reuse or post-selection effects.
